hubSection.title: About GTCFX
hubSection.description: GTCFX is a global leader in financial derivatives, established in 2012. The GTCFX brand encompasses multiple companies that provide a diverse range of online trading products, serving over 985,000 clients worldwide. GTCFX is recognized for its commitment to delivering top-tier financial services, with a strong emphasis on excellence and innovation.

legalSection.title: Legal Information
legalSection.subtitle: GTCFX Regulation
legalSection.description: GTC Group owns the following entities globally, together the GTC Financial Group. Each of these entities provides financial services according to their respective licences in the relevant jurisdiction.

australia.name: Australia
australia.text: GTC Global (Australia) Pty Ltd holds an Australian Financial Services Licence number 496371. GTC Global (Australia) focuses on providing education services to Australian clients.

mauritius.name: Mauritius
mauritius.text: GTC Global Ltd. is a limited company incorporated in Mauritius (company number: C188049) and licensed by the Financial Services Commission, Mauritius (No. GB22200292) to trade as an SEC-2.

southAfrica.name: South Africa
southAfrica.text: GTC Global SA (Pty) Ltd (Company No. 2020/810937/07) is an authorised financial services provider (FSP No. 51545). Its registered address is 18 Cavendish Road, Claremont, Cape Town, Western Cape, 7708, South Africa. The company is neither a market maker nor a product issuer and acts solely as an intermediary under the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act, 2002 (FAIS).

vanuatu.name: Vanuatu
vanuatu.text: GTC Global Trade Capital Co. Limited, is a global finance brokerage company registered, supervised, and authorized by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission of the Republic of Vanuatu Company license number: 40354. Registered address: 1/Floor, B&P House, Kumul Highway, Port Vila, Vanuatu.

cambodia.name: Cambodia
cambodia.text: GTCFX Co., Ltd. is licensed by the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia (SERC) as a Derivative Broker under licence number 043 N.M.K./A.B./Ch.U., valid from 8 October 2026 to 7 October 2028. Registered address: Building No. 40, 8th Floor, Street 289, Phum 13, Sangkat Boeung Kak 1, Khan Tuol Kork, Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

multiplier.title: Leverage Multiplier Effect
multiplier.description: Leverage amplifies both losses and profits equally. A 1% market move on a 1:100 leveraged position results in a 100% gain or loss on your margin — understanding this relationship is essential before trading with leverage.

margin.title: Leverage Ratio & Margin Relationship
margin.description: Leverage multiple determines required margin ratio: Margin = Position Value ÷ Leverage
